contextEngineeringPlan.description: This is the plan for manipulating the message context before handing off the call to the next assistant.

assistantName.description: This is the assistant to transfer the call to. You must provide either assistantName or assistantId.

assistantId.description: This is the assistant id to transfer the call to. You must provide either assistantName or assistantId.

assistant.description: This is a transient assistant to transfer the call to. You may provide a transient assistant in the response  `handoff-destination-request` in a dynamic handoff.

variableExtractionPlan.description: This is the variable extraction plan for the handoff tool.

assistantOverrides.description: These are the assistant overrides to apply to the destination assistant.

description.description: This is the description of the destination, used by the AI to choose when and how to transfer the call.
